title: Service Bus namespace with queues
description: Service Bus namespace with optional queues. SAS keys are disabled (Entra ID RBAC only), TLS 1.2. Premium adds private-only access.
security_defaults: SAS / connection-string (local) authentication disabled: Entra ID RBAC only
TLS 1.2 minimum; dead-lettering on message expiry
Public access is ON by default because turning it off needs the Premium SKU; the strict (production) policy requires Premium with public access off

sku.description: Tier. Premium gives dedicated capacity and private networking.

public_network_access_enabled.description: Reachable from the internet. false needs Premium.

max_delivery_count.description: Deliveries before a message is dead-lettered.

notes: Grant 'Azure Service Bus Data Sender / Receiver' roles separately; connection strings are disabled.
